strings.Most AI material teaches in scattered pi: 大多数 AI 教程都是零碎分散的：这里是一篇论文解读，那里是一篇微调博客，别处又是一个酷炫的智能体演示，各个拼图很难拼成完整的全貌。你上线了一个聊天机器人，却无法解释它的损失曲线；你给智能体挂接了一个函数工具，却说不清正在调用它的模型内部注意力机制究竟在做什么。
strings., four languages: Python, TypeScript, Ru: ，四种编程语言：Python、TypeScript、Rust、Julia。一端是线性代数，另一端是自主智能体蜂群。每个算法都先从纯粹的底层数学推导构建：反向传播、分词器、注意力机制、智能体循环。等到 PyTorch 登场时，你早已对底层运作了然于胸。
strings.Each lesson runs the same loop: read the: 每节课都遵循相同的认知闭环：阅读问题定义、推导数学原理、手写核心代码、运行测试验证、沉淀可复用产物。没有五分钟速成短视频，没有复制粘贴式部署，没有保姆式填鸭教学。完全免费、彻底开源，专为你自己的电脑本地运行而设计。
strings.. Every algorithm built from raw math be: 。在导入任何现成框架之前，每个算法均从原始数学原理亲手实现。
strings.AI engineering is larger than model code: AI 工程远不止模型代码本身。选择四大核心学习路径之一，直接在浏览器或 GitHub 源码中，通过相同的实验、测试和产物深入学习。
strings.Set up a working environment, run the re: 配置本地开发环境，跑通本仓库，并在选择具体方向前掌握标准的课程学习与实践流程。
strings.Move from prompts, structured outputs, e: 从提示词、结构化输出、向量嵌入与检索出发，贯穿评估体系、模型服务化、可观测性与安全发布全流程。
strings.Build the repository, environment, inter: 构建 AI 系统依赖的工程根基：仓库架构、运行环境、接口契约、系统调试、测试验证、安全防护、发布与运维保障。
strings.Frame the task, plan from repository evi: 界定任务边界，基于代码库证据制定计划，构建循环与执行框架，隔离委派职责，严格验证结果并沉淀反馈。
strings.Turn observed work into outcomes, assump: 将业务场景转化为明确成果、假设检验、可测试切片、可执行规范、衡量方案、分阶段发布与闭环反馈。
strings.Build, secure, verify, and operate state: 从底层传输信封到发布准入关卡，构建、加固、验证并运维无状态的模型上下文协议（MCP）系统。
strings.Build, invoke, route, secure, evaluate,: 在真实智能体宿主环境中，构建、调用、路由、加固、评估、打包并验证可移植的智能体技能（Agent Skills）。
strings.Choose a Claude or MCPA certification ro: 选择 Claude 或 MCPA 官方认证备考路线，完成实操实验，产出属于你自己的工程产物，并通过原创考核自测能力。
strings.Claude and Model Context Protocol Associ: Claude 与模型上下文协议认证专员（MCPA）备考路径，采用与正课一致的硬核教学方式：循序渐进、交互实验、工程产物交付，并配备直接基于 GitHub 仓库运行的 AI 导师。
strings.Not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponso: 本课程与 Anthropic、Agentic AI Foundation 或 Linux Foundation 无附属、认可、赞助或授权关系。本课程不颁发官方证书，亦不保证通过考试。
strings.The course, compiled. EPUB and PDF built: 课程编译版：每个 GitHub Release 均会自动基于最新课程生成配套的 EPUB 与 PDF 电子书。网站保持为持续更新的动态版本，每章均附带回链，方便随时查看动态交互图表、测验与代码。
strings.The entire curriculum is on GitHub. Clon: 整套课程完全开源在 GitHub 上。克隆、分叉、按自己的节奏随时学习。无需注册，更无付费墙。每节课都提供 Python、TypeScript、Rust 或 Julia 的可运行代码，精选用最契合该算法原理的语言实现。

strings.Open an issue when a published lesson, c: 当已发布的课程内容、代码示例、测验题目、翻译或网站功能存在错误，或者无法按文档说明正常使用时，请提交 Issue。当你需要帮助理解某个技术概念、想要对比不同学习路径，或者有一个需要社区反馈的想法时，请使用 GitHub Discussions。保持这些交流公开，能够让后续遇到相同疑问的学习者直接检索到答案。
strings.The course does not operate learner acco: 本课程不设学员账号体系、不搞付费注册、不设准入门槛，也不提供官方认证颁证服务。维护者会在业余时间审核公开反馈，因此无法保证即时响应。提供清晰具体的标题、相关 URL、执行的命令、软硬件环境以及观察到的实际结果，将极大方便维护者复现并快速解决问题。
strings.Do not publish secrets, private learner: 请勿在公开 Issue 中透露任何密钥、个人隐私数据或账号凭据。若报告涉及安全漏洞等敏感问题，请直接在仓库中创建私密的 GitHub Security Advisory。对于普通的内容错误、无障碍体验、课程体系或网站 Bug，请务必附上对应 URL、预期行为、实际行为以及最小复现步骤。
strings.AI Engineering from Scratch is a public,: 从零手写 AI 工程（AI Engineering from Scratch）是一套完全公开的开源课程。所有课程内容均无需注册账号、无需付费、无需创建学员档案即可随时阅读。本站绝不会索取任何密码、API 密钥或私有项目文件。
strings.Hosting and analytics providers may rece: 网站托管与基础分析服务商可能会接收常规的网络请求数据，例如 IP 地址、浏览器 User-Agent、来源页面（Referrer）、请求的 URL 以及大致访问时间。这些信息仅用于内容分发网络（CDN）加速、安全防护、汇总流量统计以及排查失效页面。本项目绝不出售任何学员数据，也绝不利用学习活动数据构建商业广告画像。
strings.Optional reading progress, theme prefere: 可选的阅读进度、主题偏好设置以及测验作答状态均仅保存在你的本地浏览器（LocalStorage）中。这些状态绝非阅读课程的硬性前提，静态网站绝不会将其作为用户记录上传至服务器。清除浏览器本地存储即可彻底移除所有本地状态。

Most AI material teaches in scattered pieces. A paper here, a fine-tuning post there, a flashy agent demo somewhere else. The pieces rarely line up. You ship a chatbot but can't explain its loss curve. You hook a function to an agent but can't say what attention does inside the model that's calling it.

, four languages: Python, TypeScript, Rust, Julia. Linear algebra at one end, autonomous swarms at the other. Every algorithm gets built from raw math first. Backprop. Tokenizer. Attention. Agent loop. By the time PyTorch shows up, you already know what it's doing under the hood.

Each lesson runs the same loop: read the problem, derive the math, write the code, run the test, keep the artifact. No five-minute videos, no copy-paste deploys, no hand-holding. Free, open source, and built to run on your own laptop.

AI Engineering from Scratch is a free, open-source curriculum that builds every core AI algorithm by hand. The curriculum spans
across 20 phases, from linear algebra to autonomous agents, in Python, TypeScript, Rust, and Julia.

The lessons are authored with AI assistance and reviewed by a human against primary sources. Where a lesson states a fact, it cites the original: an RFC, a spec, or a research paper, not a secondary summary. Corrections are welcome and tracked in the open on GitHub.
The site itself is deliberately plain: hand-written HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript, no framework. A single build script (
) reads the lesson Markdown in the repository and generates the catalog, search index, sitemap, and
on every deploy. Public curriculum counts are read from that generated data. It is hosted on Vercel.
and contributors. It is MIT-licensed and free forever. There is no token, no course upsell, and no gated content.

AI Engineering from Scratch is maintained in public. The fastest way to reach the maintainer and contributors is through the project repository, where questions stay attached to the lesson or behavior they describe and can be answered in context.

Open an issue when a published lesson, code example, quiz, translation, or website feature is incorrect or cannot be used as documented. Use a discussion when you need help understanding a concept, want to compare learning approaches, or have an idea that still needs community input. Keeping those conversations public makes the answer searchable for the next learner with the same question.

The course does not operate learner accounts, paid enrollment, admissions, or an official credential service. Maintainers review public reports as time allows, so there is no guaranteed response time. A specific title, URL, command, environment, and observed result makes a report easier to reproduce and resolve.

Do not publish secrets, private learner data, or credentials in an issue. For a security-sensitive report, open a private GitHub security advisory for the repository when the report involves a vulnerability. For ordinary content, accessibility, curriculum, or site issues, include the URL, expected behavior, actual behavior, and a minimal reproduction.

AI Engineering from Scratch is a public, open-source curriculum. The lesson content is available without an account, payment, or learner profile. The site does not ask for passwords, API keys, or private project files.

Hosting and analytics providers may receive ordinary request data such as an IP address, browser user agent, referrer, requested URL, and approximate timing. This information is used for delivery, security, aggregate traffic measurement, and diagnosing broken pages. The project does not sell learner data or use lesson activity to build advertising profiles.

Optional reading progress, theme preferences, and quiz state are stored in the browser when the site offers those controls. They are not required to read the curriculum and are not submitted as an account record by the static site. Clearing site storage removes that local state.

The optional newsletter form takes you to Substack to finish signup. The email address you enter is passed directly to Substack in the signup URL to prefill its form; this website does not store it.
